production_guardrails: All course and specialization mappings require faculty review.
All eligibility rules remain unverified until approved by admissions for the academic year.
Do not use recommendations for admission selection.
Do not present this as a validated psychometric instrument until validity and fairness studies are complete.
Student retains final choice; provide alternatives and mentor support.
